Name: XNB - Mail Assistant
Author: NuCoy07
Description:
[b]Additions: 
[/b]
[b]1. NPC Birthday Reminder [/b]
- Reminds when today is NPC's birthday, and includes suggestions for loved and liked gifts

[b]2. Traveling Cart Presence Reminder[/b] 
- Reminds every time Traveling Cart is present, namely on Friday and Sunday 

[b]3. Profitable Plant Information [/b]
- Sends information on profit/day for each plant 
- Sometimes gives useful information about plants 
- Sent at the beginning of each Season on First Year

[b]4. Last Day of Planting Reminder [/b]
- Reminds/Notifies plants that have entered the planting deadline in each season 
- Sent on Day-1 

[b]5. Fish Information Every Season [/b]
- Provides information about which fish can be caught, where, when, and in what weather
- Sometimes gives tips about fish 
- Sent at the beginning of each season (except the first year in the spring season will be sent when the player completes the quest given by Willy)
